The problem

Marketplace apps only get opened to sell. Nobody opens them to get dressed.

Yaga, Facebook Marketplace, and Gumtree only earn a visit once you already know what you're selling. QuickCloset is the app you open every morning to actually get dressed — selling is just what happens along the way.

01

Out of sight, out of mind

Once something's buried in a drawer or the back of the closet, it stops existing — so you rebuy versions of things you already own.

02

Decision fatigue, daily

Standing in front of a full closet with "nothing to wear" isn't about clothes — it's about not being able to see what actually goes together.

03

Unworn ≠ unwanted

Selling what you don't wear usually means good photos, a price, and a stranger to negotiate with — so most of it just stays in the closet.

How QuickCloset helps

Make cataloging effortless, and selling becomes a byproduct — not a project.

Catalog

Snap a photo. It's in your closet.

Photograph an item and QuickCloset lifts it cleanly off the background, tags the category, color, and size, and files it — so your whole wardrobe becomes something you can actually browse, not just own.

Build outfits

Mix and match what you already own.

Drag pieces together into full outfits, save the combinations that work, and get a suggestion pulled straight from your own closet based on today's weather — no guessing, no laundry pile archaeology.

☁️ 14° and cool — layer up
AI stylist

Learns your taste. Shops your own closet.

Show it a few photos of a look you love, and the AI Stylist learns your aesthetic — then suggests outfits made entirely from pieces you already own that match it.

Sell what you don't wear

Already photographed. Already tagged. Ready to sell.

Since your items are already cataloged, listing one for sale takes seconds — no re-shooting, no re-describing, and no downloading a separate marketplace app just to do it. It happens right where your closet already lives.
